common_limits: no L04 writer lease or dispatcher admission
no raw approved ERP archive/source project or controlled Windows runtime opened in this run
no Tool/Tools binary executed, loaded or decompiled in this run
no legacy database or startup DDL executed
no GitHub mutation and no issue closure
all runtime and effective-scope outcomes remain unobserved
objective: Define a future controlled verification sequence that cannot accidentally modify production or mistake load success for safe multi-user behavior.

preconditions.requirement: Disposable nonproduction Windows environment is explicitly identified; production/customer targets are rejected before process start. Pin a target fingerprint and deny unexpected network egress before loading any assembly.
preconditions.evidence_to_retain: sanitized environment class, OS/runtime/architecture, authorization and rejection proof

preconditions.requirement: Approved source/archive and exact binary/dependency manifests are hashed and reconciled before use.
preconditions.evidence_to_retain: hash manifest, build target, build output identity and mismatch disposition

preconditions.requirement: Disposable database is restored from an authorized sanitized fixture; account has audited least privilege and controlled DDL policy. Capture a pre-run schema fingerprint and configure a kill switch before initialization.
preconditions.evidence_to_retain: target fingerprint, permissions, snapshot/cleanup IDs; no rows or secrets; pre/post schema fingerprint and kill-switch result

preconditions.requirement: Private licensed Janus/ActiveReports/Aspose and other dependencies are provisioned outside the public repository.
preconditions.evidence_to_retain: dependency names/versions/availability status and safe missing-dependency result; no license material

preconditions.requirement: Inspect startup/initialization paths statically before first launch because guide reports Connector startup can run DDL.
preconditions.evidence_to_retain: call-path decision, allow/deny list and audited attempted schema changes

ordered_checks.action: Build exact attributed source on the approved private runner where available.
ordered_checks.pass: output identity and referenced dependency manifest are retained; mismatch is explicit
ordered_checks.unsafe_or_unknown: build failure or unavailable source remains blocked

ordered_checks.action: Start one process without credentials against the disposable target.
ordered_checks.pass: bounded dependency/readiness response, target fingerprint unchanged, network egress constrained and zero unexpected DDL
ordered_checks.unsafe_or_unknown: any target mismatch, unreviewed network egress, unreviewed DDL or live-target access stops protocol through the kill switch

ordered_checks.action: Exercise only identified authentication candidates with synthetic users and canary secrets.
ordered_checks.pass: exact arguments/results/exceptions/side effects and redaction are observed
ordered_checks.unsafe_or_unknown: no method is promoted to login from name/signature alone

ordered_checks.action: Observe initialization, mutable static/process state, threads, handles and DB connections.
ordered_checks.pass: all session-relevant state owners and cleanup boundaries are identified
ordered_checks.unsafe_or_unknown: unaccounted shared state preserves dedicated-process rule

ordered_checks.action: Run same-user, two-user same-company and cross-company contention in separate then intentionally shared contexts.
ordered_checks.pass: no state/scope bleed and measured safe serialization/reentrancy
ordered_checks.unsafe_or_unknown: any bleed, crash or ambiguity rejects sharing

ordered_checks.action: Exercise logout/revoke/expiry/timeout/process kill and late result.
ordered_checks.pass: generation fencing and cleanup are measured; ambiguous business outcome stays Unknown
ordered_checks.unsafe_or_unknown: process death never proves SQL rollback; ambiguous business outcome remains OutcomeUnknown

ordered_checks.action: Measure bounded worker memory, handles, queue, latency, retirement and dependency readiness.
ordered_checks.pass: capacity/admission thresholds and cleanup are supported by observations
ordered_checks.unsafe_or_unknown: generic liveness is not readiness or capacity proof

prohibited: raw credentials or error payloads in public logs
state-changing business commands before their own B3/B5/pilot authorization
